title: [APIV2] Return unapplied lines from the Vendor Payments API
summary: The Vendor Payments API now returns all payment lines in a batch, including unapplied payments and those with non-invoice applications, matching the behavior of the Customer Payments API.
key_points: Removed record-filtering logic that hid unapplied payment lines from the Vendor Payments API
The appliesToInvoiceNumber field is now empty for non-invoice applications instead of showing credit memo numbers
All payment lines are now visible regardless of application status or type
Added comprehensive test coverage for unapplied payments and non-invoice applications
Journal-batch scoping and POST/PATCH logic remain unchanged
